name: Care
overview: Scripture calls believers to entrust their lives and works to the Lord, promising that He will bring them to pass and establish their thoughts, as seen in Psalms 37:5 and Proverbs 16:3. It acknowledges the futility of anxious striving and encourages casting burdens upon God for sustenance and peace, exemplified in Psalms 55:22 and Psalms 127:2. Furthermore, Proverbs 21:13 warns against ignoring the cries of the poor, highlighting the importance of compassionate care rooted in obedience to God’s commands.
